userdoc.notice: Permanently holds launch position NFTs and distributes accrued fees. The contract intentionally exposes no position withdrawal or arbitrary-call function, so registered launch liquidity cannot be removed by an administrator.

initialize(address).notice: Binds the locker to one immutable launch factory.

collectFees(address).notice: Collects V3 fees and splits both assets under the configured policy.

lockPosition(address).notice: Registers and verifies permanent custody of a launched position.

getLaunchedToken(address).notice: Returns the factory record for a launch token.

deployerTokenCount(address).notice: Returns the number of tokens indexed for one deployer.

setProtocolFeeShare(uint256).notice: Changes the fee share snapshotted by future token launches.

setFeeCollector(address,bool).notice: Grants or revokes fee collection permission.

feeRecipientTokenCount(address).notice: Returns the number of tokens indexed for one fee recipient.

setFeeRedirect(address,address).notice: Redirects the creator share for one token.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: Accepts only launch NFTs transferred by the configured factory.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.initialOwner: Administrative owner for fee policy and collectors.
params.initialProtocolFeeRecipient: Recipient of the protocol fee share.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

setFeeRedirect(address,address).details: Callable by the launch deployer or the factory during launch setup.
